newsitem.title: UK: Weaker NWE gasoline continues to fuel barge buying.
newsitem.headline: Weaker NWE gasoline continues to fuel barge buying.

text.p: NWE spot gasoline prices were weaker on Tuesday in line with crude and product futures.

Traders said the weaker prices continued to fuel good barge buying interest with early trade seen at $207 to a Rotterdam refiner before the market slipped to value around $205 a tonne. Traders reported buying at $205 for tighter Amsterdam/Rotterdam liftings and offers at $205 for ARA options.

Cargo trade was thin but despite Monday's sharp about-turn from last Friday's gains on NYMEX unleaded futures, traders were optimistic about arbitrage options. "It's not as attractive as last week, but I think some people will make it work," one said.
